# Check girth
def bfs_shortest_cycle(graph):
    min_cycle = float('inf')
    for start in range(10):
        dist = {start: 0}
        parent = {start: -1}
        q = [start]
        while q:
            curr = q.pop(0)
            for nxt in graph[curr]:
                if nxt not in dist:
                    dist[nxt] = dist[curr] + 1
                    parent[nxt] = curr
                    q.append(nxt)
                elif parent[curr] != nxt:
                    min_cycle = min(min_cycle, dist[curr] + dist[nxt] + 1)
    return min_cycle

girth = bfs_shortest_cycle(adj)
print("Girth:", girth)
